entities.name: Tam
entities.description: An artificial telepath and gorgon made by the Theorist's earlier self, who kidnapped Jadzi from Strixhaven and is haunted by guilt and visions of her friends.

entities.name: The Theorist
entities.description: A clinical fragment of Jace Beleren who rules the Echoverse from his sanctum, excising his own aberrations, and plans to overwrite the original Multiverse.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: The planeswalker and mind-mage whose name is scrawled in a Vrynian textbook and whose fragments became the Theorist and aberrations.

entities.name: The First Aberration
entities.description: A younger-faced piece of Jace in a blue cloak, carved out when he dared counter the plan, who was kicked through a portal.

entities.name: Professor Opal
entities.description: A warm but wary Hexhaven professor who guards Jadzi and says Tam's duty is to her maker.

entities.name: Jadzi
entities.description: An oracle of Arcavios whom Tam kidnapped; she is locked in a cell and is to be killed for the Theorist's experiment.

entities.name: Professor Vess
entities.description: A necromancer professor imprisoned in a hexed cell at the tower's base, who taunts Tam about her betrayal.

entities.name: Denzilore
entities.description: The dean of Fatehold, a winged sphinx who soars above Hexhaven.

entities.name: Professor Zarek
entities.description: A professor who calls lights out in the cadet dormitory.

entities.name: Abigale
entities.description: An owlin friend of Tam, who appears to her in a vision signing that she lied and left.

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: A friend of Tam who appears in a vision saying she is just parts.

entities.name: Sanar
entities.description: Tam's friend, in whose dormitory the friends gathered.

entities.name: The Masked Boy
entities.description: A masked child with a knife and wound-giving magic who attacks the Theorist and is thrown through a portal.

entities.name: Hexhaven Academy
entities.description: The Echoverse's regimented university in an autumn setting, a tower reaching toward the realm of the sphinxes.

entities.name: The Echoverse
entities.description: The Theorist's manufactured, sanitized reflection of the Multiverse built without suffering.

entities.name: The Sanctum
entities.description: An immense open chamber ringed with mage-rings at the top of the tower.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The original school where Tam studied and where her friends are.

entities.name: The Parabox
entities.description: A Theorix test chamber Tam plans to use.

entities.name: Invasive Care Infirmary
entities.description: The Vigorbloom infirmary offered to the Theorist.

entities.name: Vryn
entities.description: Jace's home plane, seen in a vision of Phyrexian attack.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane whose oracles are tied to its origin.

entities.name: Aberrations
entities.description: Parts of himself the Theorist carved out, five of whom were sent through portals.

entities.name: Fatehold
entities.description: The Hexhaven school led by Denzilore.

entities.name: Quandrix
entities.description: Tam's original school.

entities.name: Theorix
entities.description: The Hexhaven school whose clothes Tam wears.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The invaders whose attack on Vryn Tam glimpses in Jace's mind.

events.summary: Tam is made and wakes to find an exhausted man who tells her that her name is Tamira but who she is is up to her.
events.quote: "Your name is Tamira, but who you are is up to you."

events.summary: He tells her she is a person in progress.
events.quote: "In progress. Yeah. You're a person in progress."

events.summary: Tam returns to Hexhaven after kidnapping Jadzi from Strixhaven, feeling empty rather than victorious.
events.quote: On paper, she returned from Strixhaven victorious, her mission complete, her captured oracle in hand.

events.summary: Tam sees a vision of Abigale accusing her of lying and leaving.
events.quote: You left , signs Abigale. You lied, and you left.

events.summary: Tam sees a vision of Lluwen telling her she is just parts.
Tam asks Professor Opal about friendship, and Opal tells her not to feel guilty for acts of service to her maker.
events.quote: Do not feel guilty for acts of service.

events.summary: Tam bursts into the sanctum to find the Theorist fighting a masked boy, who wounds him; the Theorist hurls the boy through a portal.
events.quote: the Theorist summons a portal—a great round one, rimmed with metal—and hurls the boy into it.

events.summary: The Theorist explains that excising aberrations stabilizes the Multiverse spell, and that now he is wholly one thing.
events.quote: "Yes. Now that I am wholly one thing, I know exactly who I am."

events.summary: The Theorist reveals he plans to overwrite the existing Multiverse by laying the Echoverse over it.
events.quote: "Correct. We need to overwrite the existing Multiverse to make this one stable."

events.summary: He reveals that Jadzi must die so he can follow her consciousness back to the origin of a Multiverse.
events.quote: "Oh, yes. It's the only way for the phenomenon to be observed.

events.summary: The Theorist reads Tam's mind and reassures her, and she finds a textbook with Jace Beleren's name in it.
events.quote: JACE BELEREN is scrawled in a child's hand in the upper-left corner.

events.summary: Tam visits Jadzi's cell and apologizes, and Jadzi tells her she will find what she is looking for.
Vess, imprisoned in a hexed cell, taunts Tam about betraying her friends and knowing where Jace puts his shame.
events.quote: "I know you, Beleren! I know where you put your shame!"

events.summary: Flashback: Tam found the Theorist's earlier self lost in a vision of Phyrexia's attack on Vryn.
events.quote: She knows without doubt that this was Vryn under Phyrexian attack

events.summary: Flashback: the Theorist carves the first aberration out of his mind and kicks it through a portal.
events.quote: Tam's maker suddenly ripped open a portal and kicked him through with full force.

events.summary: Tam telepathically tells the Theorist that he used her to bring Jadzi to her death, and he admits he carved away the part that knew why he made her.
events.quote: I'm not sure. I carved the one that knew away.

events.summary: Tam climbs to the roof in the night, doubts herself, and reminds herself she is in progress.
events.quote: I'm in progress , she reminds herself.

relations.note: The Theorist made Tam as an artificial being.
relations.quote: I'm a mage who made you for an incredibly special purpose

relations.note: The Theorist made the Echoverse, his grand project.
relations.quote: The Theorist did such a magnificent job of replicating the Multiverse he came from while clipping away its cruelties.

relations.note: He teaches Tam praestigial theory and telepathy.
relations.quote: The Theorist is a wonderful teacher.

relations.note: Tam carries out missions for her maker.
relations.quote: Your duty is to your maker.

relations.note: Opal watches over the captives and helps maintain the hexes.
relations.quote: alongside magic from the Theorist and Professor Opal

relations.note: The Theorist is a part of Jace, not all of him.
relations.quote: The Theorist is the man who made her, but not all of him.

relations.note: Opal is Vess's jailer, doing her job as Tam says.
Tam kidnapped Jadzi and holds her captive, to her regret.
relations.quote: who was brought here to die
